art_direction.style: Simple recognizable enchanted props, soft fantasy magic, stylized 3D with clean 2D cel shading. Avoid office stationery mechanisms, toy eyes, excessive limbs or buttons; magical runes and small natural crystals are allowed.
art_direction.model: Game-ready 3D GLB/FBX is future output only; no models yet created
art_direction.no: office hardware, modern USB plugs, alarm clocks, needle/pin for Prism, text, logos, letters, eyes, legs, humanoids or hands unless explicitly requested
art_direction.prompt_language: English prompt and Russian prompt provided for each artifact; no generated files are implied

visibility_rule: Each character-specific pickup is physically present from world load. Normal perception reveals it only through the associated character's layer; a knowledgeable player may detect and target it via collision, location address or deep scanning. A carried artifact remains a real Entity and may be transferable where mechanics allow. Never spawn it only when changing heroes.

artifacts.fx: При повороте часов песок ускоряется/замедляется, а вместе с ним вся симуляция; при паузе частицы зависают
artifacts.control: Ускоряет, замедляет и приостанавливает время всей игровой симуляции (NPC, физика, эффекты); активный игрок и интерфейс остаются управляемыми для отмены паузы

design_principles: All character-specific artifacts are physically present from world start but ordinarily visible through their owner's perception layer; deep scan or knowledge may reveal.

Luna's baseline wand can already edit NPC movement routes (one actor, nearby waypoints) and door destination; artifact ART-YU-01 enhances visual convenience and batch editing rather than granting baseline permission.
An early wand-copy trick allows the copy to hack and upgrade the original wand; changing SCAN_DEPTH, TARGET_RANGE, RULE_DEPTH and DEVELOPER_MODE unlocks advanced edits without plot flags.
ART-GL-01 magical hourglass changes WORLD_TIME_SCALE and can pause/accelerate entire simulation, with holder/controls safely exempt from pause; it is not a local object snapshot.
Removed A02 Time Anchor as a collectible from current 20-item catalog; its record remains historical in docs/38. Safe RETURN/REWIND for player recovery is a separate engine mechanic, not loot.
ART-GL-04 Prism crystal opens a secret 2D platformer; normal mode is 3D, and the same GAME_DIMENSION parameter is accessible after finale via game-frame editor.

ART-GL-06 Crystal Heart grants coarse emotional aura perception to Luna or any bearer: emotion and intensity only. Lea's innate empathic perception additionally shows needs of creatures (especially animals), directed relationships, causes, and supports more subtle interventions. Basic wand may edit simple mood variables without granting Lea's interpretive layer.
